regulatory_mapping.variant_entry_rule: PASS fine-mapping QC and membership in at least one credible set or a non-missing shared-signal posterior
regulatory_mapping.target_gene_rule: A non-missing target must already be a molecularly supported gene in the same locus; interval-only enhancer, open-chromatin, and motif overlaps retain target_gene_id=NA until a source-declared link exists; nearest-gene-only assignment is forbidden
regulatory_mapping.claim_limit: Regulatory overlap is annotation unless supported by signal-level and context-matched gene-linking evidence

screen_registry_v4.biosample_mapping_rule: Use the exact Core Collection DNase experiment accession in the matrix header and the checksum-pinned SCREEN metadata snapshot; domain membership is the frozen ontology lookup above, without post-result relabeling
screen_registry_v4.element_rule: A variant must uniquely lift from GRCh37 to GRCh38 and overlap the half-open Registry V4 cCRE interval; enhancer tasks require a biosample-specific pELS/dELS class and open-chromatin tasks require any frozen accessible class
screen_registry_v4.target_rule: SCREEN interval overlap alone does not identify a target gene and therefore records target_gene_id=NA

hocomoco_v14.sequence_snapshot_rule: Fetch only the checksum-locked GRCh38 window required for an eligible, SCREEN-accessible fine-mapped variant; retain the exact JSON response and SHA256 in results/sources before motif scoring
hocomoco_v14.scoring_rule: Use the official H14CORE PWM and its matching threshold-to-P-value map on both strands for both allele sequences; report only hits in which at least one allele has P<=1e-4 and the alternate allele changes the score
hocomoco_v14.context_rule: A motif result is eligible only when the same variant has a completed SCREEN enhancer or open-chromatin overlap in the same locked domain
hocomoco_v14.target_rule: A predicted motif effect does not identify a target gene and records target_gene_id=NA
hocomoco_v14.claim_limit: An allele-dependent motif score is a sequence-level prediction, not evidence that the TF binds or regulates a gene in vivo

abc_2021.domain_rule: Use only the 52 exact non-transformed, biologically interpretable source labels frozen by domain in the checksum-pinned component manifest; all other source biosamples are excluded from domain-specific atlas evidence
abc_2021.element_rule: Use the source half-open GRCh37 element interval and retain a fine-mapped atlas variant when start < one-based_position <= end; do not lift a native-GRCh37 ABC record
abc_2021.target_rule: Retain only a source-declared TargetGene whose exact symbol maps to exactly one molecularly supported gene in the same atlas locus; unmatched or ambiguous symbols are excluded and nearest-gene substitution is forbidden
abc_2021.score_rule: The frozen source contains ABC.Score>=0.015; retain all qualified source links and label ABC.Score>=0.02 as the prespecified primary tier without changing the released link set
abc_2021.claim_limit: An ABC link is a context-specific enhancer-gene prediction; it is not experimental proof of regulation and becomes convergent gene evidence only when supported by an independent signal-level molecular modality

pchic_2016.domain_rule: The source contains 17 primary hematopoietic contexts, all assigned to immune; the other three locked domains are NOT_APPLICABLE for this source rather than negative
pchic_2016.contact_rule: Treat the consecutive GRCh37 restriction-fragment coordinates as one-based closed intervals; for each cell type retain only CHiCAGO score>=5; a variant in an other-end fragment links to source-declared baitName promoters, while a variant in a bait links to source-declared oeName promoters only when the other end is also baited
pchic_2016.target_rule: Split source promoter names on semicolons and retain only an exact symbol mapping to exactly one molecularly supported same-locus atlas gene; dot/NA, unmatched, and ambiguous names are excluded without nearest-gene substitution
pchic_2016.deduplication_rule: Reciprocal bait-to-bait rows collapse by locus, variant, variant-containing fragment, target gene, and cell type, retaining the maximum CHiCAGO score
pchic_2016.claim_limit: A CHiCAGO-supported promoter contact is physical-proximity evidence in a primary hematopoietic context; it does not prove enhancer activity or causal transcriptional regulation

regulatory_build_harmonization.mapping_rule: For a GRCh38 annotation, each one-based fine-mapped variant position must map uniquely to one forward or reverse GRCh38 autosomal point; ambiguous or unmapped variants are excluded with terminal provenance
regulatory_build_harmonization.native_build_rule: A checksum-pinned GRCh37 annotation is queried directly against the one-based GRCh37 atlas variant after applying the source's documented interval convention

promoter_mapping.target_rule: Only the version-stripped GENCODE gene matching a molecularly supported same-locus gene can be assigned as the promoter target

fuma_scrna.dataset_selection_rule: Two prespecified independent processed matrices per domain, human where available; vascular uses the two source-provided mouse vascular matrices already mapped to human Ensembl IDs
fuma_scrna.multiple_testing_family: All cell types across the eight prespecified matrices for one trait and the FUMA_SCRNA MAGMA_Celltyping method
fuma_scrna.claim_limit: A positive MAGMA gene-property association identifies cell-type expression correlated with polygenic association after conditioning on average expression; it does not prove that the cell type or any expressed gene is causal, and mouse vascular evidence is explicitly cross-species

cell_types.multiple_testing: BH FDR within each trait-or-locus, method, and frozen dataset family
cell_types.canonical_inclusion: Only rows with within-family BH FDR <= 0.05 enter cell_types.tsv; complete null analyses remain in the coverage ledger

pathways.multiple_testing: BH FDR within each frozen resource and trait-or-locus test family
pathways.canonical_inclusion: Only rows with within-family BH FDR <= 0.05 enter pathways.tsv; complete null analyses remain in the coverage ledger

public_pathway_sources.identifier_rule: Exact unique GENCODE v26 gene-symbol mapping only; no alias, nearest-gene, or case-folded substitution
public_pathway_sources.background_rule: All exact uniquely mapped GENCODE v26 genes present in at least one eligible set in the tested resource
public_pathway_sources.null_row_rule: Retain every eligible set for each locus with at least one source-mapped high-confidence gene, including overlap=0 and P=1
public_pathway_sources.claim_limit: Pathway overrepresentation is a competitive annotation of a prespecified convergent-gene list; it does not establish pathway activity, direction, mediation, or causality

causal_inference.clump_reference: Checksum-pinned 1000 Genomes Phase 3 EUR 504-sample GRCh37 panel streamed to a preregistered SNP-major subset
causal_inference.instrument_F_formula: BETA_exposure^2 / SE_exposure^2 for every retained instrument; report the minimum
causal_inference.palindromic_rule: Drop all palindromic variants before estimation; do not infer strand from frequency
causal_inference.proxy_rule: No proxy variants and no remote/API clumping
causal_inference.steiger_rule: Use TwoSampleMR directionality on the exact retained instruments when exposure and outcome sample sizes and outcome type inputs are available; otherwise record UNCHARACTERIZED, which forbids robust causal wording
causal_inference.sample_overlap_rule: Classify overlap from checksum-locked source/cohort metadata before estimation as NONE_KNOWN, KNOWN_ADJUSTED, KNOWN_UNADJUSTED, or UNCHARACTERIZED; only the first two are compatible with robust causal wording
causal_inference.colocalization_rule: Compatibility must be derived from the same signal and alleles in the canonical molecular colocalization table; absent, discordant, or locus-ambiguous evidence cannot support robust causal wording
causal_inference.task_seed_rule: base seed plus unsigned first 8 hexadecimal digits of SHA256(task_id), modulo 2147483646, plus 1

CAUSE_or_LHC_MR_where_appropriate.lhc_mr_role: Sensitivity only for material known overlap with real LDSC intercepts and real bidirectional MR starting estimates

causal_inference.multiple_testing: BH FDR within each direction and estimator family across the locked 396 pairs
causal_inference.claim_rule: Causal language requires concordant robust estimators, adequate instruments, no material pleiotropy warning, correct Steiger direction, characterized sample overlap, and compatible signal-level colocalization

ROBUST_GLOBAL_ASSOCIATION.alternate_locus_boundaries: No locus boundary defines a global LDSC correlation
ROBUST_GLOBAL_ASSOCIATION.fine_mapping_assumptions: Global LDSC correlation does not use fine-mapping assumptions
ROBUST_GLOBAL_ASSOCIATION.colocalization_priors_and_models: Global LDSC correlation does not use colocalization priors
ROBUST_GLOBAL_ASSOCIATION.leave_one_trait_out_SEM: No validated SEM factor conclusion exists

CROSS_METHOD_SHARED_LOCUS.leave_one_trait_out_SEM: The locus conclusion is not a validated SEM factor conclusion

HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CONVERGENT_GENE.leave_one_trait_out_SEM: The gene conclusion is not a validated SEM factor conclusion

MULTI_STRATEGY_CELL_TYPE.leave_one_trait_out_SEM: The cell-type conclusion is not a validated SEM factor conclusion

FDR_SUPPORTED_PATHWAY.leave_one_trait_out_SEM: The pathway conclusion is not a validated SEM factor conclusion

ROBUST_CAUSAL_EVIDENCE.alternate_locus_boundaries: Instrument clumping does not use atlas locus boundaries
ROBUST_CAUSAL_EVIDENCE.fine_mapping_assumptions: The primary MR instrument estimators do not use fine-mapping probabilities
ROBUST_CAUSAL_EVIDENCE.leave_one_trait_out_SEM: The causal conclusion is not a validated SEM factor conclusion

claim_limit: Annotation, enrichment, association, prediction, and causal-inference estimators retain their method-specific limitations; no layer alone proves mechanism or causality
